costumes.text: InstructionsTry to beat the quiz by answering all of the questions correctlyThe questions are far from easy. Some require insane logic , others are completely down to guessing.If you get 3 answers wrong you lose    It's Hard but it's not Impossible
SORRY THIS QUIZ IS STILL             IMPOSSIBLE
What sound does a         bell make?
What can you putin a bucket to make        it lighter?
What is the seventhletter of The Alphabet
Which of the following would you     need to build a green house?
Which one of these statements                     are true?
What is next in this series
A book cost $1 plus half it's price. How much does it cost?
What Mathematical symbol can be put between these two numbers to make a new number greater than two but less than                     three

Take a million         divide it by 4     divide the result by 5          divide it by 2divide the new result by 20           subtract 50          divide it by 3       divide the result by 8              subtract 1            divide it by 7                  add 2            divide it by 3                add two            divide it by 5
How many holes in           A Polo
How many letters in          this hand?
WELL DONEYOU HAVE MADE THE IMPOSSIBLE     POSSIBLE!

Exactly nine of these statements are false
